Intel-JR0288972.title: AI GPU Arch Perf Analysis Intern
Intel-JR0288972.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
As an AI Architecture Performance Analysis Graduate Intern, you will join Intel's GPU Compute Architecture team and contribute to core GPU kernel perf analysis using real AI workloads.
Your work will directly support hardware/software co design and help analyze and shape the performance of next generation Intel GPU and AI accelerator platforms, while giving you hands on exposure to GPU architecture and low level performance engineering.

Key Responsibilities
•	Analyze and optimize core GPU compute kernels for AI and numerical workloads (e.g., GEMM, Attention, operator fusion).
•	Reproduce representative AI inference and training workloads for GPU IP validation.
•	Perform GPU performance profiling and analysis to identify compute, memory, and pipeline bottlenecks.
•	Build performance profiles and models to understand architecture level performance behavior.
•	Provide workload and kernel level insights to support GPU architecture design and HW/SW co design efforts.
Intel-JR0288972.requirements:
Minimum Qualifications
•	Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
•	Proficiency in Python for analysis, experimentation, or tooling.
•	Solid understanding of AI fundamentals, including common models and algorithms.
•	Strong interest in GPU architecture, GPU programming, parallel computing, and performance optimization.
•	Basic knowledge of computer systems, such as CPU/GPU architecture, memory systems, and performance analysis.

Preferred Qualifications
•	Experience with GPU kernels or programming models (e.g., CUDA, OpenCL, SYCL, Triton).
•	Exposure to performance optimization, compiler, or parallel computing coursework, research, or internships.
•	Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to reason from profiling data.
•	Interest in AI systems and infrastructure, beyond model level development.
•	Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross functional engineering environment.

Intel-JR0288730.title: Industrial AI Solution Arch
Intel-JR0288730.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact 
This role is to drive the exploration, architecture, and adoption of next-generation AI solutions for industrial and manufacturing applications.
This role will focus on identifying emerging Industrial AI use cases, translating customer challenges into scalable solution architectures, and accelerating the adoption of Intel platforms across the industrial ecosystem. The role will span traditional and emerging workloads including Computer Vision, 3D Vision, Edge AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI.

Business group 
The Industrial AI organization drives innovation by developing advanced AI solutions that address real-world challenges across industries. By focusing on system-level integration, this group supports Intel's mission to deliver transformative technologies that empower businesses and accelerate progress. With a commitment to engineering excellence, the team collaborates across disciplines to unlock next-generation AI opportunities. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Design and implement integrated AI systems across hardware, software, firmware, and silicon components to meet customer requirements. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define AI systems architecture, ensuring alignment between use cases, product specifications, and implementation constraints. 
- Analyze, evaluate, and optimize AI systems for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-effectiveness throughout the lifecycle. 
- Develop innovative methods in areas such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, machine learning, and robotics. 
- Conduct risk assessments and ensure system reliability, security, maintainability, and sustainability. 
- Deliver end-to-end technical solutions, including deploying AI systems, conducting benchmark tests, and preparing documentation. 
- Simulate real-life environments, analyze prototype performance, and provide actionable engineering insights. 
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and academic organizations to advance AI research, contribute to the AI product roadmap, and influence emerging trends.
- Collaborate with OEMs, ODMs, ISVs, SIs, model vendors and end customers to develop scalable Industrial AI solutions.
Intel-JR0288730.requirements:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI systems engineering with a Bachelor's degree OR 2+ years with a Master's degree OR no prior professional experience with a PhD. 
- Proficiency in deep learning algorithms, machine learning software frameworks, and AI system integration. 
- Experience with hardware-software co-design, system prototyping, and performance optimization. 
- Strong technical skills in areas such as reinforcement learning, policy learning, or computer vision. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions. 
- Excellent problem-solving skills and adaptability to evolving technical challenges. 
- Strong communication skills to translate technical concepts into actionable strategies for diverse audiences.

Intel-JR0288261.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
AI Agent Core Framework Development and Performance Optimization
Design, develop, and optimize AI Agent runtimes, agent kernels, and task execution frameworks. Research planning, reasoning, tool invocation, and execution mechanisms for agents in complex task scenarios, continuously improving execution efficiency, system reliability, and scalability.
Agent Core Infrastructure and Capability Development
Develop and enhance core Agent components, including workflows, memory systems, tool usage, and multi-agent collaboration. Optimize context management, task orchestration, state management, and execution pipelines to improve autonomous operation and decision-making capabilities in complex environments.
Agent Performance Analysis and Production Deployment
Build performance evaluation, profiling, and monitoring frameworks for Agent systems. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in large-scale and complex workloads, and drive the adoption of Agent technologies in areas such as software engineering productivity, intelligent operations, and automated engineering workflows.

Intel-JR0288612.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact 
As a Platform Structural Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing and optimizing structural designs for Intel's cutting-edge data center platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring platform integrity, reliability, and performance by designing innovative solutions that meet technical specifications and industry standards. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions powering the world's most advanced computing systems. 

Business Group 
The Data Center Group (DCG) is dedicated to advancing Intel's leadership in data center technologies by developing platforms that empower businesses and organizations globally. As part of this team, you will contribute to creating solutions that address the growing demands of cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and big data, while supporting Intel's mission to make technology accessible and transformative.

- Design and analyze structural components for data center platforms, ensuring compliance with technical specifications and industry standards. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, and testing, to optimize platform designs for reliability and scalability.

- Generate design documentation, including models, drawings, and technical reports, to support project development and manufacturing processes.

- Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation in structural design practices.

Intel-JR0288993.title: Environmental, Health and Safety Engineer
Intel-JR0288993.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact 
As an Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring Intel's compliance with local and regional environmental health and safety regulations while safeguarding the wellbeing of workers and communities. You will oversee workplace safety programs, conduct environmental risk and hazard assessments, and implement corrective actions to mitigate operational risks. Your contributions will directly support the creation of a safe and sustainable workplace where employees can thrive.

Business group 
This position is part of Intel Foundry, a business group dedicated to manufacturing excellence and innovation in semiconductor technology. Within the Research, Development, Sales and Marketing (RDSM) EHS organization, the team is responsible for advancing environmental, health, and safety programs, ensuring regulatory compliance, and promoting a strong culture of safety and sustainability. Through these efforts, the team supports Intel's operational excellence and continued industry leadership.

Key Responsibilities 
- Ensure compliance with local, regional, and Intel-specific environmental health and safety regulations. 
- Manage and deliver safety programs, including emergency procedures, workplace safety policies, and prevention training. 
- Coordinate EHS incident investigations, perform root cause analyses, and develop corrective action plans. 
- Conduct workplace environmental monitoring, risk assessments, and hazard evaluations. 
- Oversee environmental permitting, licenses, certifications, and external reporting requirements. 
- Perform audits to identify operational hazards, mitigate risks, and evaluate environmental impacts. 
- Investigate accidents to determine their causes and propose preventive measures. 
- Maintain comprehensive records of employee exposure to hazardous materials or pollutants. 
- Stay informed of changes in EHS regulations and industry best practices.
Intel-JR0288993.requirements:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Hold a certification of mid-grade Certified Safety Engineer
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health, Safety Management, or a related field, with 3+ years of hands-on experience in environmental health and safety OR a Master's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of experience. 
- Proficiency in conducting environmental risk assessments, incident investigations, and safety audits. 
- Knowledge of local and regional EHS regulations and standards. 
- Experience preparing and managing environmental permits and external reports. 
- Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver workplace safety training programs. 
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Mandarin.

Preferred Qualifications 
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to develop actionable solutions to complex EHS issues. 
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across teams and advocate for safety initiatives. 
- Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment. 

Your expertise and dedication can contribute to creating a safe, sustainable, and impactful environment at Intel. Join us and be part of a team that drives meaningful change.

Intel-JR0288445.title: HPC and Financial Workload Optimization Engineer
Intel-JR0288445.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Software Enabling and Optimization Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing software performance and driving adoption of Intel products. You will collaborate with customers, software vendors, and the open-source community to develop, optimize, and differentiate software solutions across HPC and Financial domains. By delivering high-quality software enablement, testing, and optimization, you will contribute to advancing Intel's product capabilities and ensuring seamless user experiences.
The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering and performance optimization skills with scientific and quantitative computing expertise, hands-on AI experience across HPC and financial workloads, customer engagement experience, and the ability to operate effectively across research, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will make extensive use of Intel's software tools and libraries to profile, tune, and accelerate customer applications on Intel platforms
Business group
The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of creating innovative solutions that address the needs of enterprise, cloud, and edge computing. This group focuses on enabling Intel technologies to shape the future of data-driven applications and scalable solutions. As part of DCG, you will contribute to Intel's leadership in high-performance computing and data-centric workloads, directly supporting Intel's broader goals of driving technological advancements.
Key Responsibilities
- Partner with customers and ecosystem software vendors to integrate, test, and optimize software solutions for Intel products.
- Research, prototype, and develop software that leverages Intel's product capabilities to drive adoption across market segments.
- Conduct performance tuning, debugging, and benchmarking to ensure differentiation and efficiency in software-enabled Intel technologies.
- Deliver technical collateral, training materials, and differentiated benchmarks to support customer success and ecosystem enablement.
- Influence product design, simulation, and projection strategies by identifying and driving key workloads into future product requirements.
Intel-JR0288445.requirements:
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Computational Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in software development, scientific or quantitative computing, HPC or other workload optimization, application engineering, or a closely related field.
Strong programming skills in C and/or C++, together with experience using Python or another modern scripting language.
Experience working in Linux or UNIX-based HPC or high-performance financial computing environments.
Experience with parallel programming technologies such as MPI and OpenMP.
Experience with software performance analysis, profiling, benchmarking, debugging, and optimization.
Ability to understand complex customer workloads and collaborate with internal engineering teams to drive issue resolution.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including presenting technical material to expert audiences.
Ability to manage multiple technical workstreams and operate independently in a customer-facing environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting HPC centers, research institutions, large-scale scientific computing deployments, or financial-services trading, risk, and analytics platforms.
Experience with accelerator programming technologies such as SYCL, OpenMP target offload, CUDA, or OpenCL.
Experience optimizing applications in domains such as physics, engineering simulation, computational chemistry, climate and weather, life sciences, AI for science, or financial workloads such as risk management, pricing, quantitative research, and real-time trading.
Experience with compilers, numerical and communication libraries, AI frameworks, and HPC/FSI performance analysis tools.
Familiarity with cluster environment, workload schedulers, networking, storage, low-latency interconnects, and software environment management.
Experience building sustained technical relationships with customers, academic researchers, financial-services technology teams, and ecosystem partners.
Demonstrated experience applying AI-enhanced methods in HPC or FSI environments, such as integrating AI into scientific or financial workflows, accelerating AI workloads on HPC/FSI systems

Intel-JR0289085.title: Module Engineer
Intel-JR0289085.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact 
As a Module Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of high-volume manufacturing equipment and processes that are integral to the production of cutting-edge integrated circuits. You will be responsible for conducting tests, optimizing production techniques, and implementing improvements to ensure safety, quality, and efficiency. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's ability to meet manufacturing goals and deliver industry-leading products to global markets. 

Business group 
You will be joining Intel Foundry, a team dedicated to advancing semiconductor manufacturing processes and technologies. This group supports Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class solutions by driving innovation, scaling manufacturing capacity, and ensuring excellence in production quality. Your work will contribute to the development of technologies that empower businesses and industries worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Conduct tests and measurements to ensure control over critical dimensions and defectivity in manufacturing processes. 
- Implement modifications to equipment and processes to optimize production efficiencies, techniques, and output. 
- Execute maintenance and repair activities for high-volume manufacturing equipment and associated components. 
- Develop and optimize systems for excursion prevention and discrepant material detection in equipment and processes. 
- Own process development and optimization aligned with high-volume process nodes. 
- Collaborate with equipment suppliers to enhance equipment functionality and performance. 
- Participate in the transfer of technology to global manufacturing sites, including training and auditing qualifications to ensure process matching across locations. 
- Manage equipment installation, conversion, and qualification during factory ramps to ensure safety, quality, and readiness. 
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives for safety, quality, cost, productivity, defects, and yield indicators.

Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing processes OR a Master's degree in a relevant field with at least 2 years of experience. 
- Proficiency in using advanced manufacturing equipment and tools specific to the semiconductor industry. 
- Familiarity with process control methodologies and data analysis techniques. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on continuous improvement strategies. 
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing environments and collaborating across global teams. 
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with cross-functional teams and external partners. 

Step into a role where your expertise will drive innovation and excellence in manufacturing. Join us to shape the future of semiconductor technology and make a tangible impact in the global tech landscape.

Intel-JR0286409.title: Platform Power Thermal Performance Engineer
Intel-JR0286409.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
We are looking for motivated graduate candidates who are interested in platform performance engineering for AI server platforms. In this role, you will learn and contribute to GPU-as-an-I/O-device performance validation and optimization, working across CPU host architecture, I/O subsystems, GPU device interactions, and server-level performance analysis. You will work with experienced engineers to develop validation methodologies, execute performance experiments, analyze results, and support technical issue investigation across reference designs and customer-oriented systems. This role provides a strong opportunity to build hands-on expertise in modern AI infrastructure, from single-server performance tuning to cluster-scale design concepts.
Roles and Responsibilities
•	Learn and contribute to topology validation and performance analysis for AI server platforms, covering CPU host, GPU, memory, storage, and network interactions.
•	Support validation plan development, benchmark execution, data collection, and result analysis for CPU host and GPU I/O performance studies.
•	Work with senior engineers to debug performance issues, summarize findings, and propose practical improvement ideas from the host platform perspective.
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to communicate test progress, document technical observations, and support issue closure under guidance.
Intel-JR0286409.requirements:
This role is designed for graduate candidates who want to grow into platform performance engineers. You will have opportunities to develop practical expertise in AI server architecture, CPU host performance, GPU I/O behavior, benchmarking methodology, and at-scale platform optimization concepts. We value strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, hands-on learning ability, and clear communication.
1.	Solid fundamentals in computer architecture, operating systems, or computer systems, with interest in CPU, memory, and I/O subsystem behavior.
2.	Basic understanding of GPU computing, parallel programming, or accelerator-based systems; related coursework, research, or project experience is a plus.
3.	Interest in AI infrastructure and at-scale system concepts, including server architecture, scale-up/scale-out design, networking, and storage.

Candidates should be upcoming graduates with a Master of Science degree, or higher, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. The ideal candidate is passionate about learning new technologies, solving complex system problems, and improving validation efficiency through structured analysis and automation.
•	Solid understanding of computer architecture and system fundamentals; exposure to concepts such as PCIe/CXL, coherency, IOMMU, NUMA, or host-device data movement is a plus.
•	Basic knowledge of GPU architecture, GPU programming, or AI accelerator software stacks; experience with CUDA, ROCm, OpenCL, SYCL, or related frameworks is a plus.
•	Interest in AI server and cluster-level system design, including GPU scale-up, server scale-out, networking, storage, and performance bottleneck analysis.
•	Familiarity with benchmark methodology, performance metrics, and experiment design; hands-on lab, coursework, internship, or research project experience is preferred.
•	Good programming and scripting skills, such as Python, C/C++, or shell scripting, with the ability to automate tests, process data, and support performance analysis.
•	Experience in system validation, performance testing, Linux-based development, machine learning/deep learning workloads, networking, storage, or GPU computing through internship, research, or academic projects is a plus.
•	Strong learning agility, problem-solving mindset, teamwork, and ability to work in a fast-changing technical environment.
•	Good verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to document technical findings clearly.

Intel-JR0288262.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Team and Role Overview
Intel’s Data Center Platform Engineering hardware team develops and supports platform solutions for leading cloud service providers and internet companies. These solutions integrate Intel data center products—including CPUs, GPUs, and NICs—across servers, storage systems, hardware accelerators, and infrastructure processing platforms. We are looking for a high-potential hardware engineer to help bring next-generation data center technologies to market while building a rewarding career.
You will have opportunities to:
Develop and support reference designs and products based on Intel’s latest data center platforms.
Research and apply advanced data center platform hardware technologies.
Collaborate with and learn from leading hardware and software engineers.
Work with global engineering teams across China, the United States, Mexico, India, Poland, and other locations.
Grow through structured training and career development opportunities.
Take on challenging assignments in an open and collaborative environment.
Responsibilities
Partner closely with customers and internal platform architecture teams to define next-generation data center product architectures, concepts, and critical technologies based on customer requirements.
Support customer platforms throughout the full lifecycle, from solution design and design-in through system bring-up, debugging, validation, deployment, and sustaining.
Conduct system-level feasibility analyses covering physical placement, thermal and mechanical considerations, board floor planning, and critical high-speed interface routing.
Review customer schematics and PCB layouts, and provide actionable design guidance.
Lead and coordinate cross-organizational and geographically distributed engineering teams to diagnose and resolve complex, high-priority platform issues.
Provide platform technology updates, technical training, and design consultation; answer customer questions during design enabling and design-in; and build trusted technical advisor relationships.
Contribute to emerging-technology research, platform architecture, competitive analysis, and other innovation initiatives.

Intel-JR0288426.title: Compiler Engineer
Intel-JR0288426.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Compiler Engineering team in Data Center Group at Intel has an opportunity available for a Compiler Engineer.
At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. You will contribute to an ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities.
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models.
As a Compiler Engineer, you will play a critical role in advancing compiler technologies that deliver exceptional performance and scalability across Intel architectures.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Designing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining advanced compiler technologies and software components.
• Driving the implementation of new compiler features and resolving software defects.
• Analyzing real-world applications, workloads, and benchmarks to identify optimization opportunities.
• Improving the performance and efficiency of compiler-generated code for Intel CPU architectures.
• Conducting functional, performance, scalability, and stress testing to ensure product quality and reliability.
• Partnering with hardware architects and platform teams to enable new processor capabilities.
• Collaborating across global engineering, validation, and performance teams to deliver high-quality products.
• Contributing to open-source compiler initiatives and industry standards.

Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Informatics, or a related technical field.
• 3+ years of professional software development experience and advanced knowledge in C/C++.
• Strong background in object-oriented programming, algorithms, and data structures.
• Experience optimizing software for CPU performance and efficiency.
• Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Proven ability to work independently.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills within global engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Experience with vectorization technologies and parallel programming models such as OpenMP.
• Experience with compiler development using LLVM or similar compiler frameworks.
• Knowledge of assemblers, linkers, and low-level system software.
• Strong understanding of compiler optimizations, code generation, and CPU architecture.
• Familiarity with performance profiling and analysis tools such as perf or equivalent solutions.

- Tune workloads and measure performance on Intel CPUs and GPUs, and report regressions and optimization opportunities.
- Design and implement test automation for continuous integration so performance and quality are tracked daily.
- Help connect Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI and HPC software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models.

- Implement and extend compiler components - optimization passes, code generation, runtime or offload support - under the guidance of senior engineers.
- Grow into deep expertise in a chosen area - middle-end optimization, backend code generation, heterogeneous and offload compilation, or workload performance analysis.
As a motivated software developer, you will collaborate with a multinational engineering team and have the opportunity to help redefine compiler technology and software tools.

The Role and Impact 
As a Financial Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing accounts receivable processes and ensuring timely cash collections from a designated portfolio of customers. You will manage reconciliations, address payment disputes, and collaboratively work to optimize workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's financial performance by minimizing delinquencies and driving process improvements. 

Business Group 
The Finance organization at Intel focuses on delivering financial planning, management, and operational excellence to support Intel's strategic goals. Within this group, the East Collections and AR Team is dedicated to managing customer accounts, ensuring adherence to payment terms, and driving cash collection performance. The team works closely with internal business units and external partners to foster strong financial discipline and operational efficiency.

•	Timely reconcile AR statement and follow up payment schedule to ensure collection performance meet company's KPI.
•	Detect and resolve disputes efficiently hence to minimize exposure to large or long past due. Partner with counterparts to escalate issues which may cause material delinquencies. 
•	Identify roadblocks and areas of improvements in order to cash process and customer's payment process and take effective actions to streamline process through partnering and influencing. 
•	Build valued partnership with customer's finance, Accounts Payable, procurement team and internal business teams such as Sales, Customer Operations, Logistics etc.

•	Implement AI or automation solution to enhance process efficiency and productivity.

Intel-JR0288634.title: Linux Kernel Development and Validation Engineer
Intel-JR0288634.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact 
As a System Software Engineering Graduate Intern, you will help develop, optimize, and validate Linux kernel and virtualization software. Your day-to-day work will involve hands-on tasks with AI assistance, including patch development, debugging, validation, and performance analysis to enable and optimize Intel platforms and technologies. This role offers the exciting opportunity to learn, explore, and develop your skills through meaningful projects that support Intel's business goals.

Business Group 
The role is part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), which drives innovation in data-centric solutions, enabling global connectivity and advancing the next generation of computing technologies. DCG focuses on delivering cutting-edge products and services that power cloud computing, enterprise data centers, and AI workloads, contributing to Intel's vision of a smarter, connected world.

Key Responsibilities 
- Kernel and Virtualization Development: Contribute directly to the development, upstreaming, optimization, and bug-fixing of Linux kernel subsystems, drivers, or hypervisor virtualization stacks.
- Performance Optimization and Benchmarking: Conduct hands-on benchmarking, performance profiling, and latency analysis of the cloud Linux software stack, identifying bottlenecks to optimize system throughput.
- Test Automation and Validation: Design, write, and execute robust unit and integration test cases to validate kernel and virtualization software on pre-silicon and post-silicon platforms.
Intel-JR0288634.requirements:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework or hands-on training OR a Master's degree in relevant field with no prior professional experience. 
- Systems Programming Proficiency: Strong programming foundation in C or Rust with a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and concurrency.
- Operating Systems Concepts: Solid theoretical and practical understanding of OS internals, including process management, scheduling, virtual memory, interrupts, and synchronization primitives.
- Development Tools: Direct experience working in a Linux/Unix environment, including familiarity with system utilities, shell scripting (Bash, Python), and version control systems like Git.

- Linux kernel/driver/community experience
- Work with AI on coding and code review, debugging, and performance analysis.

Intel-JR0288985.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Robotics Solution Architect to define and develop end-to-end technical solutions for humanoid robotics. This role combines deep robotics domain expertise, hands-on engineering experience, and strong system architecture capabilities to translate customer requirements into scalable, deployable solutions leveraging Intel technologies. 

The successful candidate will work closely with robotics OEMs, ecosystem partners, and internal solutions and engineering teams to address architectural challenges across compute, AI, perception, planning, control, and software infrastructure. The emphasis is on technical leadership, system integration, and engineering execution-from architecture definition and prototyping through validation and deployment. 

Key Responsibilities 

Lead end-to-end solution architecture for humanoid robotics, defining hardware and software partitioning, subsystem interfaces, compute topology, and deployment requirements. 

Translate robot-level requirements into detailed technical specifications, balancing performance, real-time responsiveness, power consumption, thermal constraints, reliability, and cost. 

Architect heterogeneous computing solutions across CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators, allocating workloads for perception, sensor fusion, localization, motion planning, and control. 

Define software architectures integrating robotics middleware, AI inference runtimes, real-time control frameworks, and development and debugging tools. 

Collaborate with robotics engineering teams to integrate embodied AI models and learning-based policies with robot software and control systems, addressing inference latency, resource constraints, and deployment readiness. 

Lead technical engagements with customers and partners, including architecture workshops, technical assessments, proof-of-concept development, integration reviews, and system-level troubleshooting. 

Establish benchmarking and validation methodologies covering end-to-end latency, throughput, timing determinism, power efficiency, and sustained operation under representative workloads. 

Develop reference architectures, technical documentation, and reusable integration guidance to accelerate engineering implementation. 

Work across silicon, platform, software, and robotics engineering teams to resolve architectural gaps and translate field requirements into actionable roadmap recommendations.

Intel-JR0287757.title: Substrate Capacity Manager
Intel-JR0287757.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Substrate Capacity Manager, you will lead strategic supplier capacity growth initiatives that are critical to Intel's ability to scale next-generation semiconductor technologies. This role combines project management, supplier engagement, and capacity planning expertise to ensure substrate supply readiness for both development and high-volume manufacturing.

You will drive complex, multi-year capacity expansion programs across a global supplier network, coordinating technical, operational, and commercial workstreams to deliver capacity on time and at scale. By aligning supplier investments, manufacturing roadmaps, and business demand forecasts, you will help secure the infrastructure required to support Intel's future growth and technology leadership.

Your success will directly influence Intel's ability to accelerate product ramps, mitigate supply risks, and enable long-term manufacturing scalability.

Business group 
This position is part of Intel Foundry, a dynamic and innovative group that focuses on enabling Intel's technology leadership through robust manufacturing capabilities and supply chain excellence. The team is committed to ensuring a resilient and efficient flow of critical materials and services, supporting Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class products and solutions. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Lead end-to-end supplier capacity expansion programs, managing scope, schedules, milestones, risks, and dependencies to ensure capacity is delivered in alignment with Intel's technology and production roadmaps.

-Drive cross-functional execution of capacity growth initiatives by partnering with engineering, operations, planning, finance, and supplier teams to remove barriers and meet aggressive deployment timelines.

-Develop long-range capacity strategies and investment plans that support RnD, product ramps, and high-volume manufacturing requirements.

-Track capacity build-out progress against key milestones, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans to prevent schedule, yield, or readiness gaps.

-Collaborate with suppliers to develop and execute manufacturing expansion roadmaps, including facility readiness, equipment installation, qualification, and production ramp activities.

-Support supply-demand planning processes by translating business forecasts into actionable capacity requirements and ensuring alignment between supplier capabilities and future needs.

- Analyze industry trends and market conditions to support strategic decision-making. 

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives in supplier processes to achieve operational efficiencies and support Intel's sustainability goals. 

- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to foster collaboration and alignment.
